mapper.sql: B.BILL_ID, B.ORDER_ID, B.CONTRACT_ID, B.CUST_ID, C.CUST_NM, B.BILL_DT, B.SUPPLY_AMT, B.TAX_AMT, B.TOTAL_AMT, B.ETAX_NO, B.ISSUE_STATUS, B.CLOSE_YN, B.CLOSE_YM, B.REG_DT, B.UPD_DT
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM TB_BILL B LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CUSTOMER C ON C.CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID WHERE B.BILL_ID = #{billId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BILL (BILL_ID, ORDER_ID, CONTRACT_ID, CUST_ID, BILL_DT, SUPPLY_AMT, TAX_AMT, TOTAL_AMT, ISSUE_STATUS, CLOSE_YN, REG_DT) VALUES (#{billId}, #{orderId}, #{contractId}, #{custId}, #{billDt}, #{supplyAmt}, #{taxAmt}, #{totalAmt}, '00', 'N', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BILL SET ETAX_NO = #{etaxNo}, ISSUE_STATUS = #{issueStatus}, UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE BILL_ID = #{billId}
UPDATE TB_BILL SET CLOSE_YN = 'Y', CLOSE_YM = #{closeYm}, UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE ISSUE_STATUS = '10' AND CLOSE_YN = 'N' AND DATE_FORMAT(BILL_DT, '%Y%m') <= #{closeYm}
